purpose: Single-use TikTok @wildvox same-day release, future valid slot only; never YouTube or Buffer.

review.image_review: Inspected source 00-07 three-frame preview strips; original and new v2 final review contact sheets; extracted actual v2 MP4 frames at 0,2,...,38s (20 time points).
review.truthfulness: All scenes depict a common kingfisher, not fish capture; hook shows blue/orange bill; second source visibly preens; two different water-edge perches and distant vegetation scenes match six narration blocks; no false fish-capture labels.
review.presentation: Six targeted static portrait crops improve visibility without camera zoom or motion; two wider authentic habitat shots remain uncropped to retain small off-center birds (not unrelated filler). Subtitles and overlays remain readable in central safe area.
review.original_film: Eight unique Commons source files, eight actual videos; no still-only or synthetic fillers; all species and locations represented generically without conflating distinct recordings.
review.audio_video: 39.15 seconds, 1080×1920 H.264 30 fps and AAC 24 kHz Kokoro am_michael narration.
review.shot_constraints: 8 semantically paired authentic shots; max segment 7.70s; 6 measured Kokoro speech blocks, chronological footage pairing verified at 2s frame sampling.
review.freeze: Independent FFmpeg freezedetect at n=-60dB:d=1s yielded no frozen intervals; additionally checked subsecond center-frame ROI changes from 0.2–7.2s and 34–36s, real low-motion birds not treated as stills.
review.attribution: 8 source creators, Commons pages and CC BY 3.0/4.0 license URLs with modification disclosure present in 1604-character TikTok caption; matching creator audit run 42714316467 success.
review.explicit_warning: No approval of previous fingerprints or other five daily candidates. Technical CI alone did not determine decision.
